verdict.rationale: OpenRouter is fundamentally an API product: extensive first-party docs cover the unified chat completions endpoint, streaming, tool calling, model routing/fallbacks, key management, and an OpenAPI spec plus a live, keyless /api/v1/models endpoint confirm a documented, programmatically accessible public API. Community evidence corroborates real-world programmatic use (switching models, key minting, billing caps) reinforcing that it is driven via API in production.
